penalties.authority: National Stock Exchange of India Limited
penalties.details: National Stock Exchange of India Limited has imposed a fine of Rs. 5,000 for delayed submission of Related Party Transaction Disclosure for the quarter ended 30th September 2025 under Regulation 23(9) of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015
penalties.impact: No impact on financial, operation or other activities of the Corporation. The Corporation has filed a waiver application with National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) on 18th December, 2025 as the disclosure of Related Party Transaction was filed with BSE limited on the date of publication of financial results, i.e., November 14, 2025. The delay in submission to NSE by 1 day occurred due to bona fide understanding that the integrated filing mechanism would ensure automatic dissemination across both the exchanges. The lapse was entirely inadvertent and unintentional. The said waiver application is under consideration with NSE.

operating_notes.text: Food-bakery and dairy segment (Britannia) contributed ₹19,162.78 Cr of FY26 segment revenue and ₹3,218.79 Cr of segment result.
Q4FY26 exceptional gain of ₹87.70 Cr came from first-phase sale of Dunsandle estate assets; a ₹15 Cr advance is held for the second phase.
Subsidiary Britannia Industries recognised ₹48.56 Cr past service cost in Q3FY26 towards gratuity and leave liabilities under the New Labour Codes.
Nowrosjee Wadia and Sons Limited holds 3,49,54,826 BBTC shares (50.10%) after acquiring 22,45,000 shares from Mr. Nusli Neville Wadia at ₹1,200 each on 16 October 2026.
